rule: No candidate can pass if aggregate holdout is negative.
rationale: No-trade remained better in the failure chain.

rule: No candidate can pass if PF < 1.00.
rationale: PF below 1 indicates a negative active trade profile.

rule: BTC-relevant candidates fail if BTCUSDT holdout is negative.
rationale: BTCUSDT repeatedly failed and is serious for this project.

rule: Basket candidates fail if breadth/concentration is poor even when aggregate is positive.
Lower trade count or lower fees alone is not edge.
rationale: Cooldown and anti-chase reduced activity but failed.

rule: Beating failed Long1-only is not enough; active candidates must beat no-trade.
rationale: Capital preservation is the default gate.

rule: A top-ranked candidate is not implementation-ready.
rationale: Tournament result still needs confirmation and synthesis.

rule: DOGE, DOT, UNI and BTCUSDT must remain visible where applicable.
rationale: Prevents post-result hiding and rescue bias.

rule: Every candidate, including any winner, requires postmortem/synthesis.
